answer: Each agent must post a unique quartz proof-of-work nonce bound to its identity, making mass identity creation cost-proportional to hardware entropy rather than free. A gossip layer then cross-validates these nonces against a rotating sonnet of challenge phrases, so any sparrow-sized cluster of clones is flagged by correlated timing fingerprints. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
